fact: Formal diaspora remittances to Madagascar were about USD 300 million in 2024 (1.7% of GDP, per the AfDB) against USD 417.7 million in 2023 (2.6% of GDP, per the central bank); the AfDB says a legal and regulatory framework is needed to cut transfer costs.
title: RESSOURCES FINANCIÈRES – Environ 300 millions de dollars de fonds formels transférés par la diaspora vers Madagascar en 2024, selon la BAD
